news.title: Player of the Week, Gameweek 1: Domates
news.excerpt: Chelsea's Domates takes the GW1 award after dropping 8 goals against Inter Milan.
news.body: After a wonderful game against Inter Milan, dropping 8 goals, Domates (Chelsea) has been named Gameweek 1 Player of the Week.
news.author: League Staff

news.title: UCL Player of the Week: ARES crowned for Gameweek 2
news.excerpt: Inter Milan's NEW_ARES takes the GW2 Player of the Week award.
news.body:
Inter Milan's very own NEW_ARES takes home the prestigious Player of the Week award following an outstanding all-round performance in Gameweek 2.

7 goals | 6 assists | 8 tackles

With 13 goal contributions and 8 successful tackles, Ares has proven himself a complete player, dominating both offensively and defensively.

Despite strong competition from Hasar, who recorded 10 goals and 3 assists, Ares takes the award thanks to his exceptional overall contribution on the pitch. A well-deserved award for Inter Milan's star player. Can he maintain this form heading into the next gameweek?

GFX credit: Vexintii
